user_query: I want to check the DNS propagation status for a specific website. Can you provide me with the current IP address and the categorization of the website? Additionally, I need information about the categories of the top 3 websites in Norway.

TaskList.description: Check the DNS propagation status for the specified website and retrieve the current IP address.
Categorize the retrieved website based on the current IP address.
Gather information about the top 3 websites in Norway.
Categorize the top 3 websites gathered from Norway.
